verdicts.reason: A scales the art up so the circle almost touches the text column, leaving no gutter. Its left edges also don't line up: GLACIER and the CTA start at ~372px but the headline and body start at ~381px, which looks careless, and the headline rewraps to a less balanced 'Cucumber / Mint is back'. B keeps the original grid, with every text element on one shared left edge, a clear gutter and the same hierarchy. It is basically the original re-centred, with a slightly empty, uneven band at the top and bottom, but that is fine for such a small change in aspect ratio.
